verdict.rationale: Databricks documents an official Databricks SDK for Python for automating operations, and its API reference refers to multiple 'Databricks SDKs' with call examples. Databricks Connect is also an embeddable official client library for building against Databricks compute from IDEs. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of SDKs beyond Python (other languages are only implied by the plural 'SDKs'), detail on SDK coverage and depth, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
